text: libsail builds for baseline x86-64, so a loop the compiler vectorises gets 16-byte SSE2 only. memchr and memmem pick AVX2 at run time. A perf annotate of FastaParser::parse's old whitespace fold showed pcmpeqb and pminub on xmm registers; swapping it for memchr::memchr3 took 1 GiB of protein from 0.484 s to 0.433 s. len_of in seq/fasta.rs is still such a fold.
